Multi-campus
Padua is a well-organised university city in which the buildings and facilities where you can study, work and spend your free time are spread across its various areas. And that is not all: Unipd is also a distributed campus, not only in Padua, but also with several sites across the surrounding area
Find out more
Classrooms and study spaces
We provide facilities and spaces in different areas of the city where you can study, as well as a vast bibliographic and information heritage, databases and multimedia products within libraries and media libraries
Find out more
Residences and accommodation
Padua offers the opportunity to find accommodation in more than 10 residences, colleges and hundreds of private flats located in the beautiful historic centre and in the city neighbourhoods. To tackle the phenomenon of ‘undeclared rentals’, you can make use of a standard subsidised tenancy agreement drawn up specifically by Unipd, Esu, Guardia di Finanza and the Municipality of Padua
Find out more
Wellbeing and sport
We provide a range of resources and support services to enhance the diversity and strengths of each person, and we promote students' psychological and physical wellbeing through dedicated services and projects that make it possible to pursue multiple goals, such as the one dedicated to student athletes
Find out more
Discover the city
A true student-friendly city, Padua is home to more than 70,000 students in a city of around 210,000 inhabitants: these are the proportions of a very ancient university city, where student life and city life intertwine every day. Squares filled with students, riverbanks for running in the open air, the Piovego riverbank for an aperitif in summer, and a range of cultural, musical and sporting events make the city lively and welcoming, allowing people to immerse themselves in places of history, art and beauty
Find out more
